name: Transcendent Harmony
prerequisites: Flowing Spirit Technique + Perfect Timing Technique, Spirit 4+
effect: Passive + Active. Convert 2 Harm into Fatigue; once per session become immune to Harm; allies gain +1 die to Defend rolls.
